0022600030.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-4, 2-3 on the road, coming off a loss) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, on a four-game losing streak) in the 9th game of the Raptors' season and an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) are out for Toronto, while Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Jakob Poeltl (shoulder), Kyle Anderson (illness) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Milwaukee's Kam Jones is also day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 122-94 win in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
